/*
HYPOTHESIS: If the stock price of a company has increased over the last 2 days, it may decrease in the future (time series delta of closing price today and closing price 2 days ago).

IMPLEMENTATION: If company A's stock price had increased twice as much as the stock price of another company B, the prices of both stocks may decrease in the future.  In this reversion example, stock A may not fall double stock B, though it may fall more than stock B (rank operator).

HINT: Can different neutralizations and decay settings improve this signal? Under what neutralization would a reversion idea work best?
*/

group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / cap, 250), industry)
trade_when(volume > adv20, group_rank(-((close - open) / (high - low)),subindustry), -1)
group_rank(ts_rank(est_eps / close, 252), subindustry)
0.6 * group_rank(ts_rank(est_eps / close, 252), subindustry) + 0.4 * group_rank(ts_rank(cashflow_op / assets, 252), subindustry)
group_neutralize(rank(ts_mean(ts_decay_linear(-ts_rank(returns, 5), 12), 3)), industry)
group_neutralize(ts_decay_linear(-ts_rank(returns, 5), 15), industry)

group_neutralize(rank(rank(ts_decay_linear(ts_backfill((implied_volatility_call_180 - implied_volatility_put_180) / implied_volatility_mean_180, 60), 4)) * rank(ts_decay_linear(-(close - open) / open, 2))), industry)

group_neutralize(rank(rank(ts_decay_linear(ts_backfill((implied_volatility_call_60 - implied_volatility_put_60) / implied_volatility_mean_60, 20), 3)) * rank(ts_decay_linear(-(close - open) / open, 2))), subindustry)
trade_when(pcr_oi_270 < 1, (implied_volatility_call_270 - implied_volatility_put_270), -1)
rank(ts_decay_linear(-ts_delta(vwap, 1), 3)) * rank(volume / ts_mean(volume, 100))
rank(-ts_delta(close, 1)) * rank(volume / ts_mean(volume, 80))

clv = ((close - low) - (high - close)) / (high - low + 0.001); flow = clv * volume / (adv20 + 1); fast = group_neutralize(ts_decay_linear(-flow, 5), subindustry); slow = 0.5 * group_rank(ts_rank(est_eps / (close + 0.01), 252), subindustry) + 0.5 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / (assets + 0.01), 252), subindustry); rank(0.40 * rank(fast) + 0.60 * rank(slow))

fast = group_neutralize(ts_decay_linear(-(close - open) / (open * ts_std_dev(returns, 20) + 0.0001), 4), subindustry); slow = group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / (assets + 0.01), 252), subindustry); rank(0.40 * rank(fast) + 0.60 * rank(slow))

clv = ((close - low) - (high - close)) / (high - low + 0.001); flow = clv * volume / (adv20 + 1); fast = group_neutralize(-flow, subindustry); slow = group_rank(ts_rank(est_eps / (close + 0.01), 252), subindustry); rank(0.60 * rank(fast) + 0.40 * rank(slow))

f1 = group_rank(ts_rank(cashflow_op / (cap + 0.01), 252), subindustry); f2 = group_rank(ts_rank(sales / (assets + 0.01), 252), subindustry); f3 = group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / (sales + 0.01), 252), subindustry); rank(0.40 * f1 + 0.35 * f2 + 0.25 * f3)

fast = group_neutralize(-(close - open) / (open * ts_std_dev(returns, 20)), subindustry); slow = group_rank(ts_rank(est_eps / (close + 0.01), 252), subindustry); rank(0.65 * rank(fast) + 0.35 * rank(slow))
quality = group_rank(ts_rank(est_ebitda / (est_sales + 0.01), 252), subindustry); value = group_rank(ts_rank(est_ebitda / (cap + 0.01), 252), subindustry); rank(0.55 * quality + 0.45 * value)

fast = group_neutralize(-ts_delta(close, 2) / (ts_std_dev(returns, 20) * close), subindustry); slow = group_rank(ts_rank(cashflow_op / assets, 252), subindustry); rank(0.65 * rank(fast) + 0.35 * rank(slow))

rev5 = -ts_rank(returns, 5); fast = group_neutralize(ts_decay_linear(rev5, 10), subindustry); quality = group_rank(ts_rank(est_ebitda / (est_sales + 0.01), 252), subindustry); value = group_rank(ts_rank(est_ebitda / (cap + 0.01), 252), subindustry); slow = 0.50 * quality + 0.50 * value; rank(0.28 * rank(fast) + 0.72 * rank(slow))

clv = ((close - low) - (high - close)) / (high - low + 0.001); flow = clv * volume / (adv20 + 1); vwap_dev = (close - vwap) / (close * ts_std_dev(returns, 20) + 0.0001); fast = group_neutralize(ts_decay_linear(-0.5 * flow - 0.5 * vwap_dev, 7), subindustry); slow = 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / (assets + 0.01), 252), subindustry) + 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(cashflow_op / (assets + 0.01), 252), subindustry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(est_ebitda / (est_sales + 0.01), 252), subindustry); rank(0.34 * rank(fast) + 0.66 * rank(slow))

fast = group_neutralize(ts_decay_linear(-(close - vwap) / (close * ts_std_dev(returns, 20) + 0.0001), 5), subindustry); slow = 0.50 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / (assets + 0.01), 252), subindustry) + 0.50 * group_rank(ts_rank(cashflow_op / (cap + 0.01), 252), subindustry); rank(0.40 * rank(fast) + 0.60 * rank(slow))

gap = -(open - ts_delay(close, 1)) / (ts_delay(close, 1) + 0.001) * ts_rank(volume / (adv20 + 1), 20); rev = -0.45 * ts_rank(returns, 2) - 0.35 * ts_rank(returns, 3) - 0.20 * ts_rank(returns, 5); intra = -(close - open) / (high - low + 0.001); fast = group_neutralize(ts_decay_linear(0.45 * gap + 0.35 * rev + 0.20 * intra, 7), subindustry); q1 = group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / (assets + 0.01), 252), subindustry); q2 = group_rank(ts_rank(est_ebitda / (est_sales + 0.01), 252), subindustry); q3 = group_rank(ts_rank(est_eps / (close + 0.01), 252), subindustry); val = group_rank(ts_rank(est_ebitda / (cap + 0.01), 252), subindustry); slow = 0.35 * q1 + 0.25 * q2 + 0.25 * q3 + 0.15 * val; rank(0.33 * rank(fast) + 0.67 * rank(slow))

gap = (open - ts_delay(close, 1)) / (ts_delay(close, 1) + 0.001); rev = -ts_rank(returns, 4); fast = group_neutralize(ts_decay_linear(0.55 * (-gap * volume / (adv20 + 1)) + 0.45 * rev, 7), subindustry); q1 = group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / (assets + 0.01), 252), subindustry); q2 = group_rank(ts_rank(est_ebitda / (est_sales + 0.01), 252), subindustry); q3 = group_rank(ts_rank(est_eps / (close + 0.01), 252), subindustry); val = group_rank(ts_rank(est_ebitda / (cap + 0.01), 252), subindustry); slow = 0.35 * q1 + 0.25 * q2 + 0.25 * q3 + 0.15 * val; rank(0.28 * rank(fast) + 0.72 * rank(slow))

clv = ((close - low) - (high - close)) / (high - low + 0.001); flow = clv * volume / (adv20 + 1); curvature = (close - 2 * ts_mean(close, 5) + ts_mean(close, 20)) / (ts_std_dev(close, 20) + 0.0001); fast = group_neutralize(ts_decay_linear(0.50 * -flow + 0.50 * -curvature, 6), subindustry); q1 = group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / (assets + 0.01), 252), subindustry); q2 = group_rank(ts_rank(est_ebitda / (est_sales + 0.01), 252), subindustry); val = group_rank(ts_rank(est_ebitda / (cap + 0.01), 252), subindustry); slow = 0.40 * q1 + 0.35 * q2 + 0.25 * val; rank(0.33 * rank(fast) + 0.67 * rank(slow))

wick_bias = ((high - max(open, close)) - (min(open, close) - low)) / (high - low + 0.001); curvature = (close - 2 * ts_mean(close, 5) + ts_mean(close, 20)) / (ts_std_dev(close, 20) + 0.0001); fast = group_neutralize(ts_decay_linear(0.55 * (-wick_bias * volume / (adv20 + 1)) + 0.45 * -curvature, 8), subindustry); q1 = group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / (assets + 0.01), 252), subindustry); q2 = group_rank(ts_rank(est_ebitda / (est_sales + 0.01), 252), subindustry); q3 = group_rank(ts_rank(est_eps / (close + 0.01), 252), subindustry); val = group_rank(ts_rank(est_ebitda / (cap + 0.01), 252), subindustry); slow = 0.35 * q1 + 0.25 * q2 + 0.25 * q3 + 0.15 * val; rank(0.29 * rank(fast) + 0.71 * rank(slow))

wick_bias = ((high - max(open, close)) - (min(open, close) - low)) / (high - low + 0.001); curvature = (close - 2 * ts_mean(close, 5) + ts_mean(close, 20)) / (ts_std_dev(close, 20) + 0.0001); fast = group_neutralize(ts_decay_linear(0.60 * (-wick_bias * volume / (adv20 + 1)) + 0.40 * -curvature, 7), subindustry); q1 = group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / (assets + 0.01), 252), subindustry); q2 = group_rank(ts_rank(est_ebitda / (est_sales + 0.01), 252), subindustry); q3 = group_rank(ts_rank(cashflow_op / (cap + 0.01), 252), subindustry); val = group_rank(ts_rank(est_ebitda / (cap + 0.01), 252), subindustry); slow = 0.35 * q1 + 0.25 * q2 + 0.25 * q3 + 0.15 * val; rank(0.30 * rank(fast) + 0.70 * rank(slow))

pv_corr = ts_corr(returns, volume / (adv20 + 1), 10); fast = group_neutralize(ts_decay_linear(pv_corr, 8), subindustry); q1 = group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / (assets + 0.01), 252), subindustry); q2 = group_rank(ts_rank(est_ebitda / (est_sales + 0.01), 252), subindustry); val = group_rank(ts_rank(est_ebitda / (cap + 0.01), 252), subindustry); slow = 0.40 * q1 + 0.35 * q2 + 0.25 * val; rank(0.32 * rank(fast) + 0.68 * rank(slow))

curvature = (close - 2 * ts_mean(close, 5) + ts_mean(close, 20)) / (ts_std_dev(close, 20) + 0.0001); fast = group_neutralize(ts_decay_linear(-curvature, 6), subindustry); q1 = group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / (assets + 0.01), 252), subindustry); q2 = group_rank(ts_rank(est_ebitda / (est_sales + 0.01), 252), subindustry); val = group_rank(ts_rank(est_ebitda / (cap + 0.01), 252), subindustry); slow = 0.40 * q1 + 0.35 * q2 + 0.25 * val; rank(0.33 * rank(fast) + 0.67 * rank(slow))

signed_vol = sign(close - open) * volume / (adv20 + 1); fast = group_neutralize(ts_decay_linear(-signed_vol, 8), subindustry); q1 = group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / (assets + 0.01), 252), subindustry); q2 = group_rank(ts_rank(est_ebitda / (est_sales + 0.01), 252), subindustry); val = group_rank(ts_rank(est_ebitda / (cap + 0.01), 252), subindustry); slow = 0.40 * q1 + 0.35 * q2 + 0.25 * val; rank(0.32 * rank(fast) + 0.68 * rank(slow))

vwap_disloc = -(close - vwap) / (close * ts_std_dev(returns, 20) + 0.0001); fast = group_neutralize(ts_decay_linear(vwap_disloc * (volume / (adv20 + 1)), 6), subindustry); f1 = group_rank(ts_rank(sales / (assets + 0.01), 252), subindustry); f2 = group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / (sales + 0.01), 252), subindustry); f3 = group_rank(ts_rank(cashflow_op / (cap + 0.01), 252), subindustry); slow = 0.40 * f1 + 0.35 * f2 + 0.25 * f3; rank(0.33 * rank(fast) + 0.67 * rank(slow))

eps_rev = (est_eps - ts_delay(est_eps, 63)) / (close + 0.01); fast = group_neutralize(ts_decay_linear(eps_rev, 10), subindustry); quality = group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / (assets + 0.01), 252), subindustry); value = group_rank(ts_rank(est_ebitda / (cap + 0.01), 252), subindustry); slow = 0.55 * quality + 0.45 * value; rank(0.40 * rank(fast) + 0.60 * rank(slow))

gap = -(open - ts_delay(close, 1)) / (ts_delay(close, 1) + 0.001) * ts_rank(volume / (adv20 + 1), 20); rev = -0.40 * ts_rank(returns, 2) - 0.35 * ts_rank(returns, 3) - 0.25 * ts_rank(returns, 5); intra = -(close - open) / (high - low + 0.001); fast = group_neutralize(ts_decay_linear(0.45 * gap + 0.35 * rev + 0.20 * intra, 8), subindustry); f1 = group_rank(ts_rank((sales - cogs) / (assets + 0.01), 252), subindustry); f2 = group_rank(ts_rank(equity / (cap + 0.01), 252), subindustry); f3 = group_rank(ts_rank((est_ebitda - ts_delay(est_ebitda, 63)) / (cap + 0.01), 252), subindustry); slow = 0.40 * f1 + 0.35 * f2 + 0.25 * f3; rank(0.31 * rank(fast) + 0.69 * rank(slow))

flow = -((close - low) - (high - close)) / (high - low + 0.001) * volume / (adv20 + 1); wick = -((high - max(open, close)) - (min(open, close) - low)) / (high - low + 0.001); rev = -0.6 * ts_rank(returns, 3) - 0.4 * ts_rank(returns, 5); fast = group_neutralize(ts_decay_linear(0.40 * flow + 0.35 * wick + 0.25 * rev, 8), subindustry); f1 = group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / (assets + 0.01), 252), subindustry); f2 = group_rank(ts_rank((est_ebitda - ts_delay(est_ebitda, 63)) / (cap + 0.01), 252), subindustry); f3 = group_rank(ts_rank(cashflow_op / (cap + 0.01), 252), subindustry); f4 = group_rank(ts_rank(est_ebitda / (est_sales + 0.01), 252), subindustry); slow = 0.10 * f1 + 0.45 * f2 + 0.25 * f3 + 0.20 * f4; rank(0.31 * rank(fast) + 0.69 * rank(slow))

flow = -((close - low) - (high - close)) / (high - low + 0.001) * volume / (adv20 + 1); curv = -(close - 2 * ts_mean(close, 5) + ts_mean(close, 20)) / (ts_std_dev(close, 20) + 0.0001); rev = -0.6 * ts_rank(returns, 3) - 0.4 * ts_rank(returns, 5); fast = group_neutralize(ts_decay_linear(0.40 * flow + 0.35 * curv + 0.25 * rev, 8), subindustry); f1 = group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / (assets + 0.01), 252), subindustry); f2 = group_rank(ts_rank((est_ebitda - ts_delay(est_ebitda, 63)) / (cap + 0.01), 252), subindustry); f3 = group_rank(ts_rank(cashflow_op / (cap + 0.01), 252), subindustry); f4 = group_rank(ts_rank(est_ebitda / (est_sales + 0.01), 252), subindustry); slow = 0.10 * f1 + 0.50 * f2 + 0.25 * f3 + 0.15 * f4; rank(0.31 * rank(fast) + 0.69 * rank(slow))
